definitions.explanation: Not permanent; lasting for only a limited time.
Outside the regular schedule or arrangement; arranged specially for a particular occasion.

examples.japanese: {臨時|りんじ}⟦{休業|きゅうぎょう}→休業：11541_kyuugyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is a notice of temporary closure.

examples.japanese: {臨時|りんじ}⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{伝|つた}えします→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: We bring you a special news bulletin.

examples.japanese: {臨時|りんじ}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}している→募集：03035_boshuu⟧。

examples.english: Extra trains were operated due to the typhoon.
